title: Fraunhofer HHI VVdeC through 3.2.1 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in InterPrediction::xPredInterBlk…
description: Fraunhofer HHI VVdeC versions through 3.2.1 have a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in the InterPrediction::xPredInterBlk function. This flaw can be triggered by a crafted VVC bitstream that switches the Sequence Parameter Set (SPS) to enable reference wrap-around, causing the decoder to read from missing buffers and crash. The vulnerability leads to a denial of service condition without impacting confidentiality or integrity.
